newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Republics Fund set to raise $20 million.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Republics Fund set to raise $20 million.

text.p: The Baltic Republics Fund is looking to raise $20 million via an issue of conversion, or C, shares, manager Societe Generale Emerging European Markets said.
"With Latvia and Lithuania now at the stage that Estonia was at two years ago, the opportunities are tremendous," SGEEM director Patrick Shanahan told Reuters.
The $40 million fund, which is listed in Dublin, is one of the best performing funds this year.
"A number of companies in the region are looking at capital increases," Shanahan said.
The C shares will convert once the proceeds of the issue are 90 percent invested, which will probably occur in 12-18 months after the issue, SGEEM said.
